title: Poison LLMNR / NBT-NS / mDNS
description: Answers broken name resolution (LLMNR/NBT-NS/mDNS) to impersonate servers and capture NetNTLMv1/v2 hashes; can also relay auth and run fake SMB/HTTP/FTP/SQL services.
output: Captured NetNTLM hashes from hosts on the LAN, crack or relay them.

title: Dump credentials from LSASS
description: Post-exploitation cred extractor. In Meterpreter: load mimikatz then wdigest/logonpasswords. Standalone: privilege::debug then sekurlsa::logonpasswords. Pulls plaintext, NTLM and Kerberos tickets from memory.
output: Cleartext passwords and NTLM hashes for logged-on users.

title: Remote SAM / LSA / NTDS dump
description: Remotely dumps SAM, LSA secrets and, on a DC, the NTDS.dit, account names and LM/NTLM hashes for lateral movement. Use -hashes for pass-the-hash instead of a password.
output: Dumped user:rid:lmhash:nthash lines ready for cracking or pass-the-hash.

title: Dump SAM / cached hashes
description: pwdump-style tool to extract NTLM/LanMan hashes on Windows. Upload and run after gaining access; writes <ip>.pwdump (hashes) and <ip>.cachedump (cached domain creds).
output: .pwdump and .cachedump files containing local account hashes.

title: Windows Credentials Editor
description: Extracts logon credentials from LSASS on Windows; -w tries to recover cleartext passwords. Ships in Kali under /usr/share/windows-resources/wce/, upload and run post-access.
output: Logged-on usernames with hashes, and cleartext passwords with -w.

title: Sniff for cleartext passwords
description: Display filter that surfaces packets carrying the string PASS (e.g. FTP/POP login) in a capture. Swap the string to hunt other secrets.
output: Only packets containing "PASS", read the cleartext credential.
